entry.label: Practice: Systemic constellations: use a spatial representation as a hypothesis
entry.description: Explore a fictional organisational relationship with objects, then test what the representation does and does not establish. A low-stakes tabletop orientation exercise only, not a full constellation facilitation or therapy. Spatial impressions are not evidence of absent people's feelings, motives or hidden historical facts. Use trained support for deeper work and never compel personal disclosure.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.
practice_connections: Arrange the objects to represent one interpretation of attention and contact.
Try a different arrangement and identify a real-world test.
